text:
Asha: Quick design review for the vectors inspector and export flow — spotted a few accessibility and export-column nits while testing the batch preview.
Miguel: thanks for catching, can you list the specific nits? Screenshots help.
Asha: sure — main things: 1) score column is hidden behind a small chevron and not keyboard-focusable; 2) export CSV currently omits the original input text for privacy reasons but we should offer an opt-in toggle; 3) preview density squeezes longer items so line-wrap is inconsistent.
Priya: re: opt-in toggle — product question: if we add input text to exports, we need a clear consent checkbox in UI and a note in the export modal. Also audit log entry.
Jon: technically easy to include a column, we can add a flag `include_source_text` to the export API. We should default to false.
Eli: Accessibility: the chevron to reveal columns has role="button" but no aria-expanded state. Also keyboard order jumps from row to bulk actions. Recommend making column chooser a menu with roving tabindex and proper aria-labels.
Miguel: good call. For the preview we can keep a collapsed/expanded view but make the toggle reachable at the start of the row. Suggest a compact row mode and expanded details — mapped to Cmd/Ctrl+K quick-toggle?
Asha: +1. Also copy tweak for export modal: current sentence "Export selected vectors" -> change to "Export selected vectors (includes embeddings and optional source text)" — shorter? maybe too clunky.
Priya: propose: header "Export selected vectors" and helper text: "Includes vector id, metadata, and embeddings. Toggle to include original input text (may contain PII)." That calls out privacy.
Riley: UX question: what columns should default in the CSV? I suggest: id, vector (base64), embedding_dim, score (if available), metadata (JSON). Source text off by default.
Jon: we should also add a column header mapping doc in the modal so users know field types — e.g., embedding is base64 or float list? currently it's numeric list in some exports which breaks clients. Let's standardize on JSON array for floats and provide `format=base64|json` option.
Asha: nice. For the preview UI, the rerank relevance table sort control is confusing — vertical three-dot menu with "Sort by relevance" buried inside. People expect column headers to sort. Can we show a persistent sort dropdown above the table and allow click-to-sort on score column?
Miguel: agree. Move sort controls out of kebab into toolbar. Keep per-column sort with visual indicator. Add tooltip: "Sort by relevance (descending) — uses reranker score".
Eli: keyboard users: ensure the sort dropdown is reachable and announces the active sort via aria-live region. Also when table data updates (after rerank), focus should remain stable unless user opened a row.
Priya: one more product ask — for batch inputs we want a quick way to sample N vectors for manual review before export. Add a "Sample 50" button in the preview toolbar and an option to sample by score percentile.
Jon: backend can support sample param. We'll expose `sample.size` and `sample.mode=top|random|percentile`.
Asha: design nit: spacing between avatar+id column and content column feels tight in compact mode — bump 8px -> 12px. Also add visible focus ring on the action menu.
Miguel: I'll update the Figma: compact vs dense tokens, export modal copy, and toolbar layout. Will post updated frames.
DesignBot: Uploaded image: https://files.redwood.dev/figma/screens/vectors_inspector_v3.png
Riley: quick QA note — when exporting multiple pages we currently stream per-page; need to combine into a single ZIP when user includes source text (privacy consent) so partial downloads don't leak metadata.
Jon: good catch. We'll return a single archive if `include_source_text=true`.
Asha: thanks everyone. Action items: Miguel updates Figma and copy, Jon adds export flags + archive behavior, Eli provides ARIA checklist, Priya writes export audit + consent text, Riley adds QA test cases (sampling, export with/without source). I'll follow up with a short usability test with 5 PMs.
Miguel: assigning myself, will have frames by EOD tomorrow.
Eli: I'll draft the accessibility checklist and post as a follow-up thread.
DesignBot: Reminder: design review scheduled 2pm PT tomorrow.
Priya: Adding meeting invite.
Asha: resolved for now, thanks all :thumbsup:
